# Generated by Rocketdoo (rkd ci init)
#
# Editing this file by hand is fine; a future `rkd ci init` will report it as
# "modified" and will not overwrite it unless you pass --force.
name: Rocketdoo CI

on:
  pull_request: {}
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch: {}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint addons
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install Rocketdoo and ruff
        run: pip install "rocketdoo~=3.5" ruff

      - name: Ruff check
        run: ruff check --output-format=github --target-version py312 addons/

      - name: Validate module manifests
        run: rkd deploy validate -p addons


  install:
    name: Install modules against a real Odoo
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.base_ref == 'main'

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install Rocketdoo
        run: pip install "rocketdoo~=3.5"

      - name: Regenerate the gitignored files this build needs
        run: rkd ci prepare

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      # The image is tagged as the compose file's `image:`, so the steps below
      # reuse it instead of building a second time. ignore-error keeps a cache
      # failure from failing the build.
      - name: Build the project image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          tags: demo
          load: true
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,ignore-error=true

      - name: Start PostgreSQL
        run: docker compose up -d db

      - name: Wait for PostgreSQL
        run: |
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            docker compose exec -T db pg_isready -U root && exit 0
            sleep 2
          done
          exit 1

      - name: Install the addons
        run: |
          MODULES=$(rkd ci modules)
          docker compose run --rm -T web odoo -d ci -i "${MODULES:-base}" --stop-after-init --without-demo=all

      - name: Tear down
        if: always()
        run: docker compose down -v
